{{Quote|Oh, yes -- for ''now'' the Force is still with us, but a day is coming when it will not be so!|[[Predor]] [[Skal'nas]]|<ref name="DoTJ:FW1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 1]]</ref>}}
This '''plague''' occurred sometime before the fall of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] in [[25,200 BBY]]. It drastically reduced the population of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and the survivors lost their connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
